project_info.theme: Galaxy Tab S11 Ultra Samsung DeX productivity poster
project_info.color_palette: Off-white, pastel pink desktop UI, light gray stand, black text

main_subject.detail: Productivity poster showing Samsung DeX desktop mode on a large external monitor paired with a Galaxy Tab S11 Ultra acting as a companion screen, both displaying coordinated design and task-management workflows.
main_subject.style: Photorealistic clean tech render, productivity ecosystem demo, minimalist Samsung workspace visual

composition_elements.text: Productivity powerhouse with Samsung DeX / Galaxy Tab S11 Ultra
items: Top Left: Large centered black title 'Productivity powerhouse with Samsung DeX'.
Top Right: Smaller centered subtitle 'Galaxy Tab S11 Ultra'.
Bottom Left: Small gray multi-line DeX compatibility and performance disclaimer block.
Bottom Right: White space around the tablet companion screen and monitor stand.

Center/Background: Large desktop monitor showing a pastel DeX workspace with a 'Brand Guidelines' window and left-side file panel, plus a front tablet screen showing a task list interface; both float on a clean off-white background.

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: Bright workspace clarity, gentle matte reflections, clean UI legibility

prompt.generated_prompt_string: [COMBINED PROMPT]: High quality advertising poster for Galaxy Tab S11 Ultra Samsung DeX productivity poster. Centerpiece is a large external monitor displaying a pastel desktop workspace with a 'Brand Guidelines' window and left-side file panel, paired with a Galaxy Tab S11 Ultra showing a design task list, all on a bright off-white background. Background is minimal and spacious. Surrounding elements: exact title 'Productivity powerhouse with Samsung DeX', subtitle 'Galaxy Tab S11 Ultra', and a small gray DeX compatibility disclaimer block at the bottom left. Technical style: photorealistic product render, soft studio lighting, bright UI clarity and gentle matte reflections, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
prompt.negative_prompt: dark, gloomy, blurry, flat 2d, low resolution, distorted text, messy typography, muted colors, black and white, ugly, deformed shapes, watermark, signature, cropped
